topic: pipe attribution, bf16 vector width, rows sweep; vector-pipe floor identified

findings.bf16_vector_width: a bf16 vld yields 64 elements; vcvt part=1 returns zeros, so there is no 128-element bf16 vector path to halve loads
findings.vmull: widening multiply is int32-only; no bf16 widening multiply-accumulate exists
findings.vector_bound: the kernel is vector-bound: vec busy is ~73% of 122.6 us = ~89.6 us, so this two-pass vector algorithm cannot go below ~90 us -> at best ~0.80x against a 72 us vendor reading

conclusion: SimdVF improved the ratio from ~0.39x (SimtVF) to ~0.622x, but the two-pass vector implementation has a structural ceiling near 0.8x. Reaching 1.0 needs the square-and-reduce work moved off the vector pipe (e.g. cube/matmul dot product with fp32 accumulate) or a different algorithm.
not_proven: no witness-audited measurement; vendor reading window varies (0.068-0.072 here); no acceptance; no per-shape parity
